description: This file defines constants, function prototypes, enums, and data structures related to JSON configuration management for the RdkTelcoVoiceManager component, including checksum calculations, JSON parsing, and data model defaults.

methods.name: checksum
methods.description: Calculates CRC 32 of given data buffer.

methods.name: verifyChecksumFile
methods.description: Calculates and compares checksum of JSON file against expected value.

methods.name: writeChecksumFile
methods.description: Stores checksum value into a file.

methods.name: createChecksumFile
methods.description: Creates checksum for factory default config file.

methods.name: startJsonRead
methods.description: Prevents JSON updates during read.

methods.name: stopJsonRead
methods.description: Allows JSON updates after read.

methods.name: TelcoVoiceJsonCfgSetDmDefaults
methods.description: Reads JSON config file and sets data model defaults.

methods.name: parseAndSetJsonCfg
methods.description: Recursively parses JSON and sets configuration parameters.

methods.name: deleteObject
methods.description: Deletes JSON object in current configuration.

methods.name: storeObjectString
methods.description: Stores string value in JSON config.

methods.name: storeObjectInteger
methods.description: Stores integer value in JSON config.

methods.name: storeObjectBool
methods.description: Stores boolean value in JSON config.

methods.name: storeObject
methods.description: Stores a configuration object in JSON.

methods.name: getNextObj
methods.description: Retrieves next object type in JSON hierarchy.

methods.name: getParamType
methods.description: Determines parameter type from string.

methods.name: storeServices
methods.description: Stores service configuration in JSON.

methods.name: storeVoiceProfile
methods.description: Stores voice profile configuration.

methods.name: saveCurrentFile
methods.description: Saves JSON object to current configuration file.

methods.name: jsonPwdDecode
methods.description: Decodes password from JSON.

methods.name: jsonPwdEncode
methods.description: Encodes password for JSON.
